title.narrative: Strengthening Business Integrity through Integrity Pacts and Collective Action (EVOLVE)

description.narrative: 'TI proposes a project that leverages Collective Action to contribute to a culture of corporate transparency and integrity in public contracting markets and value chains, which form the backbone of economic development and service delivery. In specific, the project will pursue two separate – but related – objectives: 1. Drive the application of Integrity Pacts (IPs) and incentives for corporate integrity in strategic public investments.2. Enable SMEs to meet direct and indirect governance/anti-corruption disclosure obligations under the EU CSDDD/CSRD in collaboration with MNEs and governments.Value of the contract is 1,500,000 Euros

recipient-country.narrative: This project is managed by TI-S which is headquartered in Germany. The countries involved are Argentina, Bulgaria, Hungary, Italy, Spain, Romania, Germany, Spain, Italy, France, Greece, Sweden, Slovakia, Netherlands, UK, Switzerland, Canada, Turkey, and Ukraine.
